audit.why: 51.06% over 188 games — genuinely even, which is what both layers say. Jayce owns the opener, Cassiopeia owns levels 3-6, Jayce reclaims on items; the phase sides already read that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike carried a cooldown, and the page never mentioned that Jayce's stance swap is 6 seconds.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 6, and Mercury Cannon/Mercury Hammer swaps on 6s. That second number is why 'his Q is down' is not a safe window in this lane — he just swaps to hammer and walks at you.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into content.mid, content.whys[3], full.breakdown.cooldowns, full.dosFull[0].d and full.loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid told the player to drop Miasma when he 'Thundering-Blows in to all-in, so the ground locks his dash out'. Thundering Blow is not a dash — it is a knockback on Jayce's hammer E. His dash is To the Skies! (hammer Q).
audit.why: Riot: Thundering Blow 'deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back'; To the Skies! 'leaps to an enemy'. Grounding stops movement abilities, so Miasma cancels the leap and does nothing about the knockback. Held for the wrong ability, the 24-second Miasma is simply wasted.
audit.corrected: content.mid, content.wants.you[1], content.spikes[2].text, content.whys[3] and full.report[5].t now name To the Skies! as the grounded ability and state plainly that the knockback is not stoppable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Jayce shreds resistances on the swap.
audit.why: Riot: in Mercury Cannon form 'the first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'. Cassiopeia builds no resistances anyway, but the player needs to know the burst that follows the swap is bigger than the tooltip damage suggests.
The weapon swap is an attack reset, so his combo opens on the swap animation rather than on a visible ability cast — the step-back cue is the swap, not the spell.

edits.before: This is your window. With ranks in Q and E you out-DPS him in any extended trade — when he swaps to hammer and Thundering-Blows in to all-in, drop Miasma under him so the ground locks his dash out, then prime with Noxious Blast and chain refreshed Twin Fangs to shred him in melee. At 6 your Petrifying Gaze is the answer to his hammer dive: face him as he commits and the cone stun turns his all-in into your kill. Punish him every time he burns cannon Q poke and steps too close to your Miasma range.
edits.after: This is your window. With ranks in Q and E you out-DPS him in any extended trade — his hammer engage is To the Skies! (Q), so drop Miasma on his step-up and the grounding cancels that leap outright, then prime with Noxious Blast and chain Twin Fang to shred him in melee. Thundering Blow only knocks you back; it is not a dash and grounding will not stop it, so hold W for the leap. At 6, face him as he commits and Petrifying Gaze stuns — and remember his stance swap is 6 seconds, so a spent Shock Blast never means safe.

edits.before: Lay Miasma to ground him so he cannot dash, then prime with Noxious Blast and chain refreshed Twin Fangs while he is stuck in melee
edits.after: Ground his To the Skies! leap with Miasma, then prime with Noxious Blast and chain Twin Fang while he is stuck in melee with no dash out

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze answers his hammer all-in — face him as he Thundering-Blow knocks you back and the cone stun flips the kill onto you.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze answers his hammer all-in — he has to face you to leap in with To the Skies!, so the cone stun lands and flips the kill.

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E plus a Miasma ground let you pin him in melee and chain Twin Fangs faster than his hammer can keep swapping out — your trade window.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E plus Miasma grounding To the Skies! let you pin him in melee and chain Twin Fang faster than his 6-second stance swap can escape it.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Miasma for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shock Blast: 16s at rank 1 down to 6s at max, and the Acceleration Gate version is the one that hurts. - His stance swap is 6s, so a spent Shock Blast is not safety. - Miasma is 24s: save it for To the Skies!.

edits.before: Track Jayce’s Shock Blast: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Miasma grounds To the Skies!, never Thundering Blow's knockback. His first cannon-form attack shreds your armour and MR — expect it.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia vs Jayce - Track: Jayce Shock Blast. - E only poisoned targets — mana is the lane. - Shock Blast down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia vs Jayce - Track: Shock Blast, 16s at rank 1. - E only poisoned targets — mana is the lane. - W grounds To the Skies!, never the knockback. - Stance swap is 6s.

edits.before: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Gate-accelerated Shock Blast stops on the first minion — stand behind the wave and close after it fires.

edits.before: That’s Jayce’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His weapon swap resets the attack — the swap animation is your cue, not the cast.

notes: The full layer's phase 'why' strings for this matchup are champion-wide boilerplate — they mention neither Jayce nor Shock Blast and are word-for-word identical to Cassiopeia's Jax, Karma and Kayle rows. Left them alone rather than fabricate seven Jayce-specific power shifts, but they are the weakest content on the page. Did not touch the Acceleration Gate description anywhere: Riot's text confirms the gate boosts Shock Blast's speed, range and damage, which the page already states correctly.
